name: Oka Finance
description: The onchain RWA layer. Buy 700+ tokenized stocks at the best price in one click, across 6+ issuers and 6+ chains.
longDescription:
oka is the onchain RWA layer. Buy tokenized stocks with stablecoins, at the best all-in price, in a wallet you actually own.

The same stock exists as a dozen different tokens. xStocks, Ondo, Coinbase, Robinhood and Backpack each mint their own version, across Base, Solana, Arbitrum, BSC, Ethereum and Robinhood Chain. Each one trades in its own pool, at its own price. Buy the wrong one, and you've already lost money before the stock even moves.

oka scans every open listing, over 700 stocks and ETFs, nearly 3,000 listings, and fills the one that nets you the most stock once bridging, spread and gas are counted. Everything shows up as one portfolio, one balance.

Signing in creates your wallet: email, Google, X or a passkey. No seed phrase, no extension. Keys stay exportable, so it's yours.

That covers the stock itself: no leverage, no way to short it. For that, there's a second layer of 98 real-world markets: equities, ETFs, indices, commodities, FX, pre-IPO, bonds, compute. Long or short, market or limit, cross or isolated, 1x to 50x.
